subject:
Re: ZenLytics POC 

Week 1 planning and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenlytics.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenLytics POC — next steps & success criteria (post-call recap)

Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to get aligned on goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan: 

1) Primary success criteria (please confirm):
   - Functional: Redwood must generate actionable insights from the ZenLytics product taxonomy at >= 85% precision on the sample labels you provided.
   - Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for typical request sizes (batch size 1-2).
   - Cost target: keep inference cost under $0.006 per 1k tokens for the evaluation workload.
   - Ops: model availability >= 99% during evaluation window.

2) Evaluation plan & ownership:
   - ZenLytics owner: Priya Kumar to coordinate labeled examples and review results.
   - Redwood technical lead: Marcus Lin (cc'd) will handle model selection/quantization and run initial baselines.
   - Provisioning: Dev Patel (cc'd) will provision a private trial environment and manage dataset ingestion access.

3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Week 0 (this week): Exchange sample dataset and SOW sign-off.
   - Week 1: Baseline results (accuracy + latency) and config recommendations.
   - Week 2: Iteration on prompts/quantization + report.
   - Week 3: Final evaluation and decision checkpoint.

4) Next steps (action items):
   - Alex/Priya: Confirm success criteria (especially latency and cost targets) and nominate any additional reviewers.
   - I'll send the SOW and a POC map (attached) + a proposed calendar invite for the kickoff.

Attachments: zenlytics_poc_map.xlsx, redwood_poc_sow_v1.pdf

If that looks right, Priya can reply with when you can share the sample dataset and whether Michael (CTO) should be part of the weekly check-ins.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — nice summary. A few quick items: 

- The functional / accuracy target looks good. One tweak on the cost target: can we aim for ~$0.005 per 1k tokens as a stretch target and keep $0.006 as the committed constraint?
- Latency target of p95 < 300ms is fine. We'll provide a representative traffic pattern so you can run realistic baselines.

Priya will own day-to-day evaluation and coordinate label access. Michael Chen (CTO) wants to be looped in on the kickoff but not on every weekly sync.

We can share a sanitized sample dataset by Wednesday (11 Mar). I'll confirm the exact file format tomorrow — likely a CSV with text_id, text, label columns.

Thanks — Alex
